title: Higher-order Spatially Separated Correlations and Quantum Magic in the Long-range Transverse Field Ising Model
summary: Long-range interacting quantum systems exhibit interesting phenomena beyond the nearest-neighbours regime. Such interactions can reach further separated particles and change the behaviour of many-body correlations. Here, we analyse their structure in the antiferromagnetic long-range interaction transverse field Ising model with power-law interactions decaying as $1/r^α$.
